Delineate survey units end to end

Source: R/fn_patches.R
survey_units.Rd

One call runs the whole pipeline: watershed -> patches -> subdivide -> attributes -> polygons. It binarises and delineates patches (delineate_patches), subdivides each oversized patch by the chosen lever (method = "band" -> band_subpatches; method = "kmeans" -> cap_subpatches), scores per-unit and per-patch probability (unit_prob), occupancy (a single point overlay), acreage, priority band, and optional AOA tag, and returns both the patch- and unit-level results plus a one-row summary. Only the suitable cells are ever read into memory (via terra::cells + indexed reads), so peak memory scales with the suitable set, not the landscape.

Usage

survey_units(
  pr,
  occ_pts,
  method = c("band", "kmeans"),
  sens_spec = 0.45,
  delta = 0.05,
  min_area = 300,
  band_brks = c(0.45, 0.55, 0.7, 0.85, 1.0001),
  band_minac = c(2, 1, 0.5, 0),
  trig_ac = 20,
  maxcap_ac = 20,
  max_area_ac = 10,
  aoa_di = NULL,
  aoa_thresh = 1,
  work_dir = tempdir(),
  cache_dir = NULL,
  out_gpkg = NULL,
  seed = 1,
  cores = 1
)

Arguments

pr

Probability surface: a SpatRaster or a path to one.

occ_pts

Occurrence points: a SpatVector or a path to one (same CRS as pr).

method

Subdivision lever: "band" (suitability banding) or "kmeans" (geometric cap).

sens_spec, delta, min_area

Patch delineation thresholds (see delineate_patches).

band_brks, band_minac, trig_ac, maxcap_ac

Banding-lever parameters (see band_subpatches).

max_area_ac

k-means-lever cap in acres (see cap_subpatches).

aoa_di

Optional DI surface (SpatRaster or path) for the AOA tag; NULL to skip.

aoa_thresh

In-domain DI threshold.

work_dir

Directory for the watershed intermediate rasters (defaults to a temp dir).

cache_dir

Optional directory to memoise the patch/unit rasters; NULL disables.

out_gpkg

Optional path to write (and cache) the unit polygons.

seed

Base random seed for the k-means steps (applied per patch; see band_subpatches).

cores

Integer worker count for the per-patch subdivision (1 = serial). Output is identical for any core count, so cores only affects speed, not the result or the cache. Forks via parallel; serial on Windows.

Value

A list: patch_raster, unit_raster (SpatRasters); patches, units (per-patch and per-unit attribute tables); polygons (unit SpatVector); and summary (one-row data.frame).

Details

Heavy steps are memoised when cache_dir is set: the patch raster, the unit raster, and (when out_gpkg is given) the polygons are reused unless a signature of the inputs changes.

See also

delineate_patches, band_subpatches, cap_subpatches
